The plate holds what looks like 2–3 strips of cooked bacon. Cooked bacon runs about 40–45 kcal and 8–10 g per strip. I counted roughly 3 strips, two overlapping and one lying separately, and estimated about 9 g each, so about 27 g in total. At roughly 5 kcal/g, that comes to about 135 kcal. Bacon this crisp is probably a little lighter, so I rounded down to 130 kcal.
